tasks.failure_reason: Architectural blocker: task requires PsBash.Core to embed PsBash.Cmdlets.dll as an embedded resource, but PsBash.Cmdlets has a compile-time ProjectReference to PsBash.Core (uses PsBash.Core.Transpiler/Parser types). EmbeddedResource items resolve at the embedder build; for Core to embed Cmdlets.dll, Cmdlets must build before Core, but Cmdlets builds after Core. Strict build-ordering contradiction with no clean workaround. Re-entrant <MSBuild> call, two-pass build, and committing a prebuilt binary are all rejected by eagle-eyed discipline; the deadlock history (reverted commits f18bedd, 6f264eb) is in this exact code path. Correct fix is project-graph restructuring (new leaf project downstream of both Core+Cmdlets to own ModuleExtractor+embedding, OR split Core transpiler into a PsBash.Transpiler project both depend on) which exceeds the 5-file context-sized limit and contradicts the task as written (embed in PsBash.Core, ModuleExtractor extracts).

Project-graph move is structurally correct and complete (new PsBash.Transpiler leaf project; git mv'd Parser/+Transpiler/ 9 files as pure renames keeping PsBash.Core.* namespaces for zero using-churn; Core.csproj and Cmdlets.csproj reference Transpiler; added to sln; ps-bash.sln builds 0 errors; dependency graph verified acyclic via dotnet list reference; Cmdlets no longer references Core). BUT it introduces a deterministic runtime type-resolution regression: EvalDifferentialTests fails 3 tests (Differential_Eval_CmdSubMultilineExports_CompletesUnder2s, Differential_Eval_FnmShapedPayload_CompletesUnder2s, Differential_Eval_QuotedCmdSubMultiline_CompletesUnder2s). Root cause: PsEmitter.EmitEval (PsEmitter.cs:2888) emits a runtime PowerShell string [PsBash.Core.Transpiler.BashTranspiler]::Transpile(...) executed via Invoke-Expression in the ps-bash-host SDK runspace; PowerShell's [Type] literal resolver only finds types in already-loaded runspace assemblies. Before the move BashTranspiler was in PsBash.Core.dll which ps-bash-host.dll references and loads at startup; after the move it is in PsBash.Transpiler.dll which is declared in ps-bash-host.deps.json and physically present but not eagerly loaded, so the type silently fails to resolve and eval produces empty output. Verified by clean-HEAD baseline-diff: clean Debug binary outputs '1 2', changed Debug binary outputs empty, reproduced 4x; clean-HEAD isolation 9/9 pass, changed-tree isolation 3/9 fail. Acceptance criterion 'all existing tests green via ./scripts/test.sh' is NOT met.
